text:
Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically bivalve mollusks such as oysters and mussels.

Adapting elements from the hip-hop genre to enrich the artistic concept of the exhibition: The relentless pace of urban life is mirrored in the sharp, syncopated beats of the playlist, creating a rhythmic tension that parallels the hurried footsteps of city dwellers. The lyrical flow of the tracks weaves a narrative of resilience and grit, much like the rough exterior of an oyster shell protecting the lustrous pearl within. This auditory layer transforms the gallery space into a dynamic soundscape where the raw energy of the streets meets the refined beauty of the art, inviting visitors to experience the city not just as a visual environment, but as a living, breathing entity with its own distinct rhythm and soul.
